data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order context initialization.** All plugins are constructed before any `onInvocationStart` hook runs, but the refactored OTel plugins now extract context, read `Span.current()`, and create invocation spans in their constructors. An earlier plugin that installs propagation context in its start hook therefore no longer influences OTel parenting or sampling. Interleave factory creation with start hooks, or move OTel initialization back into `onInvocationStart` with safe publication; add a two-plugin ordering test.
